title: mechGEA
text: GEA methods two limitations: ignore uncertainty allele frequencies. Allele frequencies estimated finite, often incomplete sample genotypes, low-coverage data genotypes uncertain. Treating estimates known can bias downstream inference. phenomenological. Regression-based approaches (e.g. GLMs) assume particular shape relationship environment allele frequency, loosely connected evolutionary theory. mechGEA instead builds analysis explicit model evolution.

title: mechGEA
text: mechGEA hierarchical Bayesian model, three linked levels: Data model: links observed sequencing data unobserved patch-level allele frequencies via genotype likelihoods, uncertainty low read depth, small samples missing data carried analysis. Process model: describes evolutionary forces generate allele frequencies. Building Wright’s island model, allele frequencies patch settle equilibrium shaped drift, mutation migration, tilted selection whose strength depends local environmental conditions. locus gets environmental sensitivity coefficient (β); neutral loci β ≈ 0, adaptive loci track environment across patches. Parameter model: encodes expectation neutral theory genome local selection. horseshoe prior β shrinks loci towards zero letting strongly associated loci escape, limits false positives across thousands loci. practice, pipeline (1) estimates migration among sampled patches, (2) fits GEA model accounting migration, (3) reports per-locus, per-environment β estimates credible intervals. Loci whose credible intervals exclude zero candidates local adaptation.
